pkgmetadata.longdescription: mc6 is a fork of GNU Midnight Commander, based on 4.8.33, whose panel contents can come from dynamically loaded plugins: git, docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, S3, FTP/FTPS, SFTP, Samba, systemd, shell connections and an archive manager. It replaces the built-in ftpfs, sftpfs, tarfs and cpiofs VFS modules with those plugins, adds the mcstruct structured binary viewer and a Lua runtime extension, and installs as /usr/bin/mc, so it cannot be installed alongside app-misc/mc.

use.flag: Build the FTP/FTPS panel plugin (needs net-misc/curl)
Build the MongoDB browser panel plugin
Build the S3 object storage panel plugin (needs net-misc/curl with AWS SigV4)
Build the SFTP panel plugin and use net-libs/libssh2 as the shell-link transport
Use sys-libs/slang instead of sys-libs/ncurses as the screen library
Pull in a spell-checking backend (app-text/aspell or app-text/hunspell) for the internal editor; it is opened at run time, so nothing is built differently
Build the read-only SQLite database browser panel plugin
